Sleep paralysis can leave someone awake but unable to move or speak while falling asleep or waking. Across cultures, that experience has been interpreted through figures such as the Old Hag and other night visitors.

campaigns.rights: Mocchy via Wikimedia Commons; credit recorded on PRN case page

Hachiōji Castle fell in a single day.

On 23 June 1590, Toyotomi forces destroyed the mountain stronghold. A centuries-deep haunting tradition later grew around the ruins, including stories of spectral samurai, screams and battle sounds. Those reports remain unverified; the violent historical event is documented.
